description: TypeScript Node pre-dispatch and post-dispatch AbortSignal cancellation with fresh-signal recovery
qualification: Local normal node built from combined unmerged source, separately built client candidate and disposable signer; not hosted, browser or distribution qualification.
preDispatch: Pre-aborted signal returned local cancellation with not-dispatched outcome, original selector and no fabricated observation.
limitations: Post-dispatch abort occurred after a durable business rejection while its response was withheld; cancellation during commit and after successful commitment remain untested.
The proxy counted the observed request stream and no additional queued connections; this is not a universal retry proof.
The fixture deliberately made a separate changed-input conflict probe and a distinct later business command; neither was an automatic retry.
Guest execution count was not independently measured. All later effects were acknowledged before the controlled crash.
Two preceding attempts stopped during node startup at nodeServices: unavailable; their cause remains unclassified.
